title: A creator uploads a video
label: POST
caption: The app posts the file to the API gateway, which fronts every service.

title: The gateway hands it to the upload service
label: RECEIVE
caption: Routing by path: /videos belongs to the upload service.

title: The original goes to blob storage
label: STORE
caption: handleUpload streams the original into the blob store before anything else happens.

title: A transcode job is queued
label: ENQUEUE
caption: The upload service answers the creator now; the heavy work waits in the queue.

title: A transcoder takes the job
label: TRANSCODE
caption: A worker takes the job and renders the renditions clients can stream.

title: Renditions go back to the blob store
label: RENDITIONS
caption: Each rendition is written beside the original, keyed by video and quality.

title: The catalog marks the video ready
label: READY
caption: The transcoder tells the catalog service, which updates the catalog database; the video is now playable.

title: A viewer opens a video
label: WATCH
caption: The app asks the gateway for /watch/v1.

title: The catalog service resolves it
label: LOOKUP
caption: resolveWatch reads the video's row: its renditions and where they live.

title: A manifest comes back
label: RESOLVE
caption: The manifest lists segment URLs on the CDN, not the blob store.

title: The gateway returns the manifest
label: DELIVER
caption: The app can now fetch segments without touching our services again.

title: The app fetches a segment from the CDN
label: SEGMENT
caption: Segments are plain files: the edge serves them, not the catalog.

title: The edge misses and fetches from blob storage
label: EDGE MISS
caption: The first viewer in a region pays the fetch from our blob store; the CDN keeps the segment.

title: Segments stream from the edge
label: PLAY
caption: Later viewers near this edge are served from the CDN's cache, without touching our services.
